Attackers exploited an authentication vulnerability, exfiltrating 1.2 terabytes of proprietary data. The incident has triggered security review

title: Pine Labs, Google Cloud Partner to Bring Gemini AI Agents to Merchants
summary: Pine Labs partners with Google Cloud to deploy Gemini-powered AI agents for Indian merchants, covering advertising, payments and customer support.
